first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses both the 4% completion decline and the 6% activation decline, with prior evidence of durable SMB activation gains. Promotional pricing is relevant to competitor pressure, but its acquisition lift may introduce margin or downstream customer-quality risk; verify it as a contingency rather than spend this week’s sole slot on it. Monitor qualified pipeline, retention, and revenue quality—not just completion and activation—to ensure the lift translates into sustainable revenue.
